shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin, wood and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the main subject of the photo whole inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps it whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.edit: This is a precise edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph with one detail changed. Change only what the instruction names.

assets.item: A classroom / It is a classroom.
assets.prompt: An EMPTY classroom in a school, seen from the back of the room. Four tidy rows of small one-person student desks with chairs fill the room and all face a large, completely blank white board on the front wall; one bigger desk stands at the front beside the board. Big windows on the left let in daylight. There are NO people at all. The board is clean and blank, the walls are bare, and nothing lies on the desks: no posters, maps, clocks, books or screens. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

assets.item: A class / It is a class.
assets.prompt: A CLASS of adults during a lesson, the people are the subject. Seen from the side at eye level: six adult students of different ages sit close together at two rows of desks in the middle of the photo, all looking toward a woman who stands at the front on the right and speaks to them with an open hand; two of the students have a raised hand. The students' faces and the standing woman are sharp and fill most of the photo; the room behind them is soft and plain. The board behind the woman is completely blank. Open notebooks lie on the desks but nothing on them is readable. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

assets.item: A student / She is a student.

She is seen from the knees up and is sharp; behind her the corridor with plain closed classroom doors is softly blurred. Exactly one person; no desks, no tables and no chairs.
